$schema.summary: JSON Schema reference for Claude Code settings

advisorModel.summary: Pick which model answers when Claude asks the advisor tool
advisorModel.typeText: string, one of the aliases "fable", "opus", or "sonnet", which resolve to Claude Code's current default version of that model family, or a full model ID such as "claude-opus-5-5"
advisorModel.default: unset, so the advisor is off

agent.summary: Start every session as a named subagent with its prompt, tools, and model
agent.typeText: string, the name of a built-in or custom agent
agent.default: unset, so the main thread runs as Claude Code's default agent

agentPushNotifEnabled.summary: Let Claude send a push notification to your phone when it decides to

values.summary: Claude can send a push notification to your phone when it decides one is worth sending
Claude doesn't send those notifications

allowAllClaudeAiMcps.summary: Load the claude.ai connectors Claude Code fetches itself alongside a deployed managed-mcp.json
allowAllClaudeAiMcps.default: false, so a deployed managed-mcp.json suppresses the claude.ai connectors Claude Code fetches itself

values.summary: Claude Code loads the claude.ai connectors alongside a deployed managed-mcp.json
a deployed managed-mcp.json takes exclusive control of MCP servers and suppresses the claude.ai connectors Claude Code fetches itself

allowClaudeInChromeWithManagedMcp.summary: Let the built-in Claude in Chrome server run alongside a deployed managed-mcp.json
allowClaudeInChromeWithManagedMcp.default: false, so a deployed managed-mcp.json blocks Claude in Chrome in terminal sessions

values.summary: the built-in Claude in Chrome server can run alongside a deployed managed-mcp.json
a deployed managed-mcp.json blocks Claude in Chrome in terminal sessions

allowedChannelPlugins.summary: Replace the default allowlist of channel plugins that can push messages
allowedChannelPlugins.typeText: array of objects, each with marketplace and plugin strings. An entry can instead be a "plugin@marketplace" string such as "telegram@claude-plugins-official", which Claude Code treats as the equivalent object. The string form requires Claude Code v2.1.267 or later; earlier versions reject the whole allowedChannelPlugins value when it contains one
allowedChannelPlugins.default: unset, so Claude Code uses the default Anthropic allowlist

marketplace.summary: Name of the marketplace the channel plugin is installed from

plugin.summary: Name of the channel plugin allowed to run

allowedHttpHookUrls.summary: Limit which URLs HTTP hooks can target
allowedHttpHookUrls.typeText: array of URL patterns, with * as a wildcard
allowedHttpHookUrls.default: unset, so any URL is allowed

allowedMcpServers.summary: Allowlist which MCP servers users can add
allowedMcpServers.typeText: array of objects, each with exactly one key. Use serverName, a string limited to letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores; serverCommand, an array of the command and its arguments matched exactly; or serverUrl, a URL pattern with * wildcards
allowedMcpServers.default: unset, so every server is allowed; an empty array blocks every server users add

serverName.summary: Name of the MCP server that users are allowed to configure

serverCommand.summary: Exact command and arguments used to start stdio servers

serverUrl.summary: URL pattern for remote servers, supports wildcards (e.g., https://*.example.com/*)

allowedProviders.summary: Limit which API providers a machine may use
allowedProviders.typeText: array of strings, each one of:
allowedProviders.default: unset, so any provider can be used

values.summary: the Anthropic API on Anthropic's own host, through a claude.ai or Console sign-in or an API key
Amazon Bedrock
Google Cloud's Agent Platform, formerly Vertex AI
Microsoft Foundry
Claude Platform on AWS
the Amazon Bedrock Mantle endpoint
the Anthropic API or a cloud provider's API sent to another host, such as an LLM gateway named by ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL or by a provider's endpoint variable such as ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_BASE_URL
a Cloud gateway sign-in

allowManagedHooksOnly.summary: Run only the hooks your organization deploys
allowManagedHooksOnly.default: unset, so hooks from every settings scope and plugin run

values.summary: only managed hooks run, plus Agent SDK hooks and hooks from plugins your managed settings force-enable
hooks from every settings scope and plugin run

allowManagedMcpServersOnly.summary: Make the managed MCP allowlist the only one that applies
allowManagedMcpServersOnly.default: false, so allowlists from every settings scope merge

values.summary: Claude Code reads allowedMcpServers from managed settings alone and ignores allowlists in user, project, and local settings
allowlists from every settings scope merge

allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly.summary: Make managed settings the only settings source of permission rules
allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly.default: unset, so Claude Code applies permission rules from user, project, and local settings and from --settings, in addition to the managed ones

values.summary: managed settings become the only settings source of permission rules
Claude Code applies permission rules from user, project, local, and --settings files in addition to the managed ones

alwaysThinkingEnabled.summary: Turn extended thinking off for every session
alwaysThinkingEnabled.default: unset, so thinking is on for models that support it

values.summary: no effect; thinking is already on
Claude Code turns extended thinking off for every session

apiKeyHelper.summary: Generate the API credential with your own command
apiKeyHelper.default: unset, so Claude Code doesn't run a helper

appendPlugins.summary: Run your organization's mods after every mod a user installs

askUserQuestionTimeout.summary: Let an unanswered question auto-continue after idle time

attribution.summary: Customize the attribution Claude Code adds to commits and pull requests
attribution.typeText: object with commit and pr strings and a sessionUrl Boolean, or false to hide all attribution. The false value requires Claude Code v2.1.281 or later; earlier versions reject it and skip the whole user, project, or local settings file that holds it
attribution.default: unset, so Claude Code uses the standard attribution shown under each sub-key

commit.summary: Change or hide the trailer Claude Code adds to commits
commit.default: unset, so Claude Code adds Co-Authored-By: <name> <noreply@anthropic.com>. The name is the model in use when the commit is made, such as Claude Sonnet 5. When a subagent makes the commit, the trailer names the subagent's model.

pr.summary: Change or hide the attribution line in pull request descriptions
pr.default: unset, so Claude Code adds 🤖 Generated with Claude Code

sessionUrl.summary: Omit the claude.ai session link from cloud and Remote Control commits

values.summary: Claude Code appends the claude.ai session link when it commits or opens a pull request from a cloud or Remote Control session
Claude Code omits the link

autoCompactEnabled.summary: Turn automatic compaction off or on

values.summary: Claude Code compacts the conversation automatically when context approaches the limit
Claude Code doesn't compact automatically

autoCompactWindow.summary: Set how full the context gets before Claude Code compacts
autoCompactWindow.typeText: number of tokens, from 100000 to 1000000. Claude Code caps the value at your model's context window; the models overview lists each model's window
autoCompactWindow.default: unset, so Claude Code picks a window tuned for your model

autoConnectIde.summary: Connect to a running VS Code or JetBrains IDE automatically from an external terminal

values.summary: Claude Code connects to a running IDE automatically when you start it from an external terminal
Claude Code doesn't connect automatically from an external terminal; inside a VS Code or JetBrains terminal, or with --ide, it still connects

autoContinueAtUsageLimit.summary: Wait in the open session and continue the task automatically after a claude.ai usage limit resets

values.summary: after a claude.ai usage limit stops your session, Claude Code waits in the open session and continues the task automatically after the reset
Claude Code doesn't start the wait on its own

autoInstallIdeExtension.summary: Turn off automatic install of the IDE extension from a VS Code terminal

values.summary: Claude Code installs the IDE extension automatically when you run it from a VS Code terminal
Claude Code doesn't install the extension automatically

autoMemoryDirectory.summary: Store auto memory in a directory you choose
autoMemoryDirectory.typeText: string, an absolute or ~/-prefixed directory path

autoMemoryEnabled.summary: Turn auto memory off or on

values.summary: the same as unset; auto memory stays on unless something that outranks this key turns it off for the session, such as --bare, safe mode, or CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY
Claude doesn't read from or write to the auto memory directory

autoMode.summary: Add your own allow and deny rules to the auto mode classifier
autoMode.typeText: object with environment, allow, soft_deny, and hard_deny arrays of prose rules, plus the classifyAllShell Boolean
autoMode.default: unset, so the classifier uses only its built-in rules

allow.summary: Rules for the auto mode classifier allow section

soft_deny.summary: Rules for the auto mode classifier soft-deny section

environment.summary: Entries for the auto mode classifier environment section

hard_deny.summary: Rules for the auto mode classifier hard-deny section

classifyAllShell.summary: Send every shell command through the auto mode classifier, even ones a narrow allow rule matches

values.summary: while auto mode is active, Claude Code sends every Bash and PowerShell command through the classifier and suspends your shell allow rules; outside auto mode the rules still apply

auto mode suspends only allow rules that could run arbitrary code, such as Bash(*) and Bash(python *); a command that any other allow rule matches skips the classifier unless it carries per-command a…

autoScrollEnabled.summary: Follow new output to the bottom in fullscreen rendering

values.summary: the conversation follows new output to the bottom
you stay where you scrolled while Claude keeps working; permission prompts still appear below the transcript

autoUpdatesChannel.summary: Follow the stable release channel instead of latest

values.summary: updates follow the most recent release
updates follow a version that is typically about one week old and skips releases with major regressions

availableModels.summary: Restrict which models people can pick
availableModels.typeText: array of model aliases or IDs
availableModels.default: unset, so every model is available

availableModelsMatch.summary: Make each availableModels model ID entry permit only the version it names

values.summary: a model ID entry permits its version and any model ID that extends it with another segment
a model ID entry permits only the version it names, so "claude-opus-5" permits Opus 5 but not claude-opus-5-5

awaySummaryEnabled.summary: Turn off the session recap shown when you come back to the terminal
awaySummaryEnabled.default: unset, so the recap is on

values.summary: you see a one-line session recap when you return after a few minutes away
Claude Code shows no recap

awsAuthRefresh.summary: Refresh expired Bedrock credentials in.aws with your own command
awsAuthRefresh.default: unset, so Claude Code doesn't refresh AWS credentials for you

awsCredentialExport.summary: Supply Bedrock credentials as JSON from your own command
awsCredentialExport.default: unset, so Claude Code uses the ambient AWS credential chain

axScreenReader.default: unset, so screen-reader mode is off

values.summary: Claude Code renders flat text without decorative borders or animations, using the classic renderer
Claude Code renders normally

bashEditDiffEnabled.summary: Record the files that changed while a Bash command ran in every permission mode
bashEditDiffEnabled.default: unset, so Claude Code records changes in auto mode and bypassPermissions mode when it directs Claude to edit files through Bash

bashOutputMaxChars.summary: Set how much of a successful command's output Claude receives inline
bashOutputMaxChars.typeText: number of characters, a positive integer. Claude Code clamps the value into the range 4000 to 128000
bashOutputMaxChars.default: unset, so Claude receives up to 30,000 characters inline

blockedMarketplaces.summary: Block plugin marketplace sources for your organization
blockedMarketplaces.typeText: array of marketplace source objects, in the same forms as strictKnownMarketplaces
blockedMarketplaces.default: unset, so no marketplace is blocked

items.summary: Stops skills-directory plugins (folders under ~/.claude/skills/ or a project's.claude/skills/ that carry a.claude-plugin/plugin.json) from loading

source.summary: Block marketplace fetched from direct URL

url.summary: Direct URL to marketplace.json file

headers.summary: Custom HTTP headers (e.g., for authentication)

ref.summary: Git branch or tag to use

hostPattern.summary: Regex pattern to match the host/domain extracted from any marketplace source type

pathPattern.summary: Regex pattern to match file or directory paths for marketplace sources

browserExternalPageTools.summary: Keep Claude's tools off external pages in the desktop Browser pane
browserExternalPageTools.typeText: string, "disabled"; the desktop app also accepts "disable", in either case
browserExternalPageTools.default: unset, so Claude's tools work on external pages

channelsEnabled.default: unset; channels are blocked on Team and Enterprise plans and on Console accounts with managed settings, and allowed on Pro and Max plans and on Console accounts without managed settings

values.summary: Claude Code allows channels for your organization
the same as unset; whether channels are blocked depends on your plan, as the Default says

claudeInChromeDefaultEnabled.summary: Turn on Chrome integration when a session starts, in the interactive CLI and the VS Code extension
claudeInChromeDefaultEnabled.default: unset, so Chrome integration is off and Claude Code can still offer to set it up

values.summary: Claude Code turns on Chrome integration when an interactive CLI session starts, as it does when you pass --chrome
interactive CLI sessions start with Chrome integration off, and Claude Code stops offering to set it up

claudeMd.summary: Inject organization-wide CLAUDE.md instructions from managed settings
claudeMd.typeText: string, the text of a CLAUDE.md file; write it as you would the file, Markdown included, with line breaks as \n

claudeMdExcludes.summary: Skip specific CLAUDE.md files when memory loads
claudeMdExcludes.typeText: array of strings, each a glob pattern or absolute path
claudeMdExcludes.default: unset, so Claude Code loads every CLAUDE.md it finds

cleanupPeriodDays.summary: Choose how many days Claude Code keeps transcripts before deleting them
cleanupPeriodDays.typeText: number of days, a whole number, minimum 1

companyAnnouncements.summary: Show your organization's announcements at startup

copyFullResponse.summary: Make /copy copy the full response without showing the picker

values.summary: /copy copies the full response without showing the picker
when the response contains code blocks or blockquotes, /copy shows a picker where you choose one block or the full response

copyOnSelect.summary: Turn off automatic copying of text you select with the mouse in fullscreen rendering and agent view

values.summary: Claude Code copies text to your clipboard when you finish selecting it
selecting text leaves your clipboard unchanged, and you copy the selection with a keyboard shortcut instead

crossSessionInbound.summary: Choose whether Claude Code delivers messages from your other sessions, shows a notice without delivering them, or refuses them
crossSessionInbound.default: unset, so Claude Code decides per message

values.summary: Claude Code delivers the message to Claude
Claude Code shows a notice for the message without delivering it
Claude Code drops the message

defaultShell.summary: Choose whether Bash or PowerShell runs the shell commands you type with the ! prefix
defaultShell.default: "bash", or "powershell" on Windows when Bash isn't available

values.summary: Claude Code runs your ! commands in Bash
Claude Code runs your ! commands in PowerShell

defaultToAgentsView.summary: Open agent view instead of a new conversation when you run claude with no arguments

values.summary: claude with no arguments opens agent view, unless agent view is turned off
claude with no arguments starts a new conversation

deniedMcpServers.summary: Block specific MCP servers by URL, command, or name
deniedMcpServers.typeText: array of objects, each with exactly one key: serverName, a string, so a claude.ai connector's display name such as "claude.ai Slack" works; serverCommand, an array of the command and its arguments matched exactly; or serverUrl, a URL pattern with * wildcards
deniedMcpServers.default: unset, so no server is blocked; an empty array also blocks nothing

serverName.summary: Name of the MCP server that is explicitly blocked

serverCommand.summary: Exact command and arguments used to start stdio servers

serverUrl.summary: URL pattern for remote servers, supports wildcards (e.g., https://*.example.com/*)

deniedModels.summary: Block specific models, even ones availableModels permits
deniedModels.typeText: array of model aliases or IDs
deniedModels.default: unset, so no model is blocked

desktopSessionCleanupPeriodDays.summary: Set an age limit in days for Claude Desktop and Cowork transcripts
desktopSessionCleanupPeriodDays.typeText: number of days, a whole number, minimum 0

dialogExpiry.summary: Set how long Claude Code waits for Remote Control or an SDK host to answer a forwarded dialog before it cancels the dialog
dialogExpiry.typeText: string, one of "60s", "5m", "10m", or "never", which disables the deadline

diffTool.summary: Choose whether Claude's proposed file changes open in the VS Code or JetBrains diff viewer or stay in the terminal

values.summary: Claude Code opens the diff in the IDE's diff viewer when a VS Code or JetBrains IDE is connected

disableAgentView.summary: Turn off background agents and agent view

values.summary: Claude Code turns off claude agents, --bg, /background, and the on-demand supervisor

disableAllHooks.summary: Turn off hooks, a custom status line, and a custom @ file suggestion command at once

values.summary: Claude Code turns off hooks, any custom status line, and any custom file suggestion command
hooks, the status line, and the file suggestion command run

disableArtifact.summary: Deprecated; use enableArtifact to turn the Artifact tool off
disableArtifact.default: unset, so the tool follows your account's availability

disableAutoMode.summary: Remove auto mode from the permission mode cycle
